messages:
liz: Heads-up: onboarding sample app produced duplicate outbound calls when a token rotation overlapped a 429. Quick local repro attached.
andre: ouch. node or python sample?
liz: node. Sequence: request A -> 429, token refresh kicked off -> client retries request A with refreshed token while server processed original -> double delivery. Logs: 

```
POST /api/outbound -> 429
sdk refresh -> retry POST /api/outbound (new token) -> 200
server handled both (no idempotency header present)
```

liz: The sample sets `Idempotency-Key` header, but the SDK's refresh path sometimes rebuilds the request and the header gets lost before retry.
mike: that sounds like the old whitelist-clone bug. Are we normalizing header names? IIRC go uses `x-rw-idempotency`.
olga: yep parity issue. We should pick one canonical header (proposal: `x-redwood-idempotency`) and make SDKs accept common variants.
kevin: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) fix Node's refresh flow to preserve all headers; 2) add a small client-side retry-guard (in-memory TTL set) keyed by idempotency token to avoid immediate duplicate retries. Put behind feature flag `client_retry_guard`.
andre: client guard only helps single-process; still recommend server-side idempotency. But it's a good low-risk stopgap.
mike: agreed. If we add guard, ensure TTL + eviction and a cap to avoid OOM. Also emit a metric when a retry is suppressed so we can monitor.

liz: plan I'm going to run with: preserve headers in refresh path in Node SDK + implement prototype TTL guard (3s default) behind flag. Add unit tests and an e2e script that simulates token rotation mid-request.
olga: I'll draft a mini-RFC for canonical header name and a response header `Idempotency-Cache: cached|new` so clients can observe server-side dedupe.
kevin: also add CI test in sampleapp that flips tokens during a request. make it run in the e2e matrix.
andre: reviewers: @mike @olga. ci-bot: please create issue INC-1002 and link PRs when ready.
ci-bot: created INC-1002: "Duplicate outbound delivery on token-rotation + 429".
liz: will open PR for node fix + retry_guard prototype in a few hours, include README note about setting idempotency keys and avoiding automatic replays for payment endpoints. :thumbsup:
